```
def _item_accepted(self, slot, item):
    feed_options = self.feeds[slot.uri_template]
    # check item_classes
    accepted_classes = feed_options.get('item_classes')
    if accepted_classes:
        if not isinstance(item, accepted_classes):
            return False
    # check item_filter
    item_filter = feed_options.get('item_filter')
    if item_filter:
        # instantiate if class
        if isinstance(item_filter, type):
            checker = item_filter(feed_options)
        else:
            checker = item_filter
        # if has accepts method
        if hasattr(checker, 'accepts'):
            return checker.accepts(item)
        # else callable
        return bool(checker(item))
    return True
```
